title: Formulary Benefit Exception Approvals Timed to the Plan Year: Starting Period of a Standard Non-Formulary Approval
content:
Under the Formulary Benefit, the starting period of a standard non-formulary exception approval follows the member's plan year. The plan year start date is read from the member's Pharmacy Benefit Plan enrollment.

**Months remaining.** The plan year's **12** months less the whole months from the plan year start date to the decision date.

**Clause.**
1. When no more than **3** months of the current plan year remain (the tail quarter), the starting period is those remaining months plus the 12 plan-year months, so that the approval ends with the next plan year.
2. When more than 3 but no more than **6** months remain (the tail half), the starting period is those remaining months plus the half-year of **6** months.
3. In every other case, the starting period is the formulary's standard approval length, which is **12** months on every Northbridge formulary.

The approval period is worked from this starting period. The floor of one month applies only to the finished period.

## Worked cases (hypothetical plan year starting 1 January)

| Decision date | Whole months since the start | Months remaining | Starting period |
|---|---|---|---|
| 15 October | 9 | 3 | 3 plus 12, which is 15 |
| 20 August | 7 | 5 | 5 plus 6, which is 11 |
| 1 July | 6 | 6 | 6 plus 6, which is 12 |
| 10 March | 2 | 10 | 12 |
| 31 December | 11 | 1 | 1 plus 12, which is 13 |
